title: App Offer
description: Metadata-only advertisement of a shareable dataset in response to `fdc3.data.advertiseDatasets`. Identifies the offering instance, the context type that can be retrieved, where its JSON Schema lives (so custom types resolve), FDC3 DisplayMetadata for UI chrome, and Dublin Core metadata describing the offered resource. The BaseContext `id` MUST include `dataId`, which consumers echo in `fdc3.data.dataRequest` when raising `GetAppData`. Does not carry the dataset.

id.title: Offer identifiers
id.description: FDC3 context `id` map for this offer. `dataId` is required and is the opaque handle consumers pass back in `fdc3.data.dataRequest` (via `GetAppData`) to select this specific offered dataset when an app instance advertises more than one.

dataId.title: dataId
dataId.description: Stable identifier for this offered dataset within the offering app instance. Minted by the data app; unique among that instance's concurrent offers. Consumers copy this value into `fdc3.data.dataRequest.id.dataId` when raising `GetAppData`.

source.title: Source
source.description: FDC3 AppIdentifier of the offering app instance. Both `appId` and `instanceId` are required so the consumer can target `GetAppData` / `raiseIntent` at this instance.

contextType.title: Context type
contextType.description: FDC3 context `type` string that this offer can supply when `GetAppData` succeeds — e.g. `fdc3.instrument`, `fdc3.data.tabularData`, or an org-specific type such as `myorg.riskBook`.

schemaUrl.title: Schema URL
schemaUrl.description: Absolute URI of the JSON Schema that defines `contextType` (typically the schema `$id`). Required so consumers can validate custom / non-standard types that are not shipped in the FDC3 context suite — e.g. `https://fdc3.finos.org/schemas/next/context/instrument.schema.json` or a vendor-hosted schema.

displayMetadata.title: Display metadata
displayMetadata.description: Hints for rendering this offer in UI, aligned with FDC3 API `DisplayMetadata` (name, color, glyph) as used for channel display. `name` is the user-visible label for what is being offered; `color` / `glyph` are optional presentation hints.

name.title: name
name.description: A user-readable name for what is displayed, e.g. "Portfolio Greeks".

color.title: color
color.description: Optional color associated with this offer in UI, e.g. `0xFF0000` (FDC3 DisplayMetadata.color).

glyph.title: glyph
glyph.description: Optional URL of an image used when displaying this offer (FDC3 DisplayMetadata.glyph).

metadata.title: Dublin Core metadata
metadata.description: Descriptive metadata for the offered resource using the [Dublin Core Metadata Element Set (DCMES)](https://www.dublincore.org/specifications/dublin-core/dces/) fifteen elements. Nested under `metadata` so DC `type` / `source` do not collide with the offer's FDC3 `type` or AppIdentifier `source`.

title.title: dc:title
title.description: A name given to the resource.

creator.title: dc:creator
creator.description: An entity primarily responsible for making the resource.

publisher.title: dc:publisher
publisher.description: An entity responsible for making the resource available.

contributor.title: dc:contributor
contributor.description: An entity responsible for making contributions to the resource.

date.title: dc:date
date.description: A point or period of time associated with an event in the lifecycle of the resource (ISO 8601).

type.title: dc:type
type.description: The nature or genre of the resource (DCMI Type Vocabulary recommended, e.g. Dataset, Image, Text).

format.title: dc:format
format.description: The file format, physical medium, or dimensions of the resource (e.g. MIME type).

identifier.title: dc:identifier
identifier.description: An unambiguous reference to the resource within a given context.

source.title: dc:source
source.description: A related resource from which the described resource is derived.

language.title: dc:language
language.description: A language of the resource (RFC 5646 / BCP 47 recommended, e.g. en-US).

coverage.title: dc:coverage
coverage.description: The spatial or temporal topic of the resource, or jurisdiction under which it is relevant.

rights.title: dc:rights
rights.description: Information about rights held in and over the resource.
